resources.string: Zeyao reads the browser address bar so it can show a summary before a news page opens. Your API key never leaves the device (it is only sent to the AI provider you chose), and unrelated screen content is not collected.
Local VPN is on. Traffic is not sent to a remote server.
Enable Zeyao’s accessibility service in system settings to read full news URLs.
You can change this later in Other.
Read the key points before the article opens.
Choose the AI provider for summaries. The key stays on this device only.
The key is stored encrypted on this device only. It is never written to source, logs, or the cloud. Zeyao uses it only to request summaries from %1$s.
Initialization failed. Check the network and key, then try again.
Intercept news URLs and show Zeyao before the article opens.
Turning this on will request local VPN permission.
Keep intercepting as a foreground service and try to restore after reboot. The system may ask you to ignore battery optimization.

Off by default. When on, a small floating button appears. Tap it once to arm the next click. WeChat and Google Discover are preferred. If WeChat has no URL in the node, long-press to copy the link, then tap again. Requires accessibility and overlay permission.
Off by default. When on, Zeyao tries to go back immediately so the original page is less likely to load. Some apps may still navigate.
Current: %1$s. The same site will not be intercepted again during this time.
Currently using %1$s. The key stays on this device. You can reconfigure the provider and API key here.
Even when intercept is off, you can paste a news URL to preview the Zeyao page. Back and Open appear immediately; the summary streams in.
Choose the interface language. Some text updates the next time you open the related page.
Zeyao 0.1.5\nA Wusper app. Intercepts news pages locally and generates streaming summaries with your own AI key.
